logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.

moments.description: The High Priest aggressively marches down the chapel aisle with armed guards to place the sanctuary under Crown seizure.
moments.key_dialogue: By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion.

moments.description: The High Priest publicly invalidates Alexander and Juliana's marriage, claiming her past as a beggar means she cannot rise with his new title.
moments.key_dialogue: Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him.

moments.description: Juliana bravely fights back against the High Priest's accusations, declaring her refusal to ask the church for permission to love.
moments.key_dialogue: I won't ask it for permission to love.

moments.description: Catherine watches the humiliation unfold from the stone archway, whispering a malicious taunt to Juliana.
moments.key_dialogue: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.

moments.description: Alexander fiercely confronts the High Priest face-to-face and demands a ten-day ecclesiastical trial to prove his marriage.
moments.key_dialogue: Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.

moments.description: The High Priest exits after setting the ten-day deadline, leaving Catherine to flash a wicked smile as she plots their destruction.
moments.key_dialogue: Ten days is plenty of time.
